meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 安装 OneCLI，配置代理保险库，将 .env 中的凭据迁移到保险库中，由 OneCLI 统一管理并在网关层安全注入，代理看不到原始密钥。
howto.when: 在运行 /update-nanoclaw 后需要设置 OneCLI 时，或首次使用 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 请帮我初始化 OneCLI 并迁移 .env 里的凭据。
say.note: 技能会自动安装和配置。

say.text: 我想把 Anthropic API 密钥存到 OneCLI 保险库中。
say.note: 技能会引导注册并迁移。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI, configures the Agent Vault gateway, migrates credentials from .env into the vault, and manages credentials via OneCLI so agents never see raw keys.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /update-nanoclaw requires OneCLI setup, or for first-time OneCLI installation.

say_en.text: Please initialize OneCLI and migrate credentials from .env.
I want to store my Anthropic API key in the OneCLI vault.
